for TTF 1 the “step+tape” geometry is not needed and for TTF 3 the fully tapered collimators are sufficient.
the optimal collimator geometry with the smallest wakefields can be obtained by a compromise between the fully tapered collimators and the step collimators.

the optimal geometry for a given collimator aperture is obtained when the step and the fully tapered collimators have the same total impedance.
the step+taper collimator with the optimal geometry is the best choice for the TTF 2 beamline.
